manifest.coordinate_system: local Cartesian; X east, Y north, Z up
manifest.status: Official archive geometry matched into synthetic city layout; source face materials retained, no new RT/channel validation.
manifest.transform: world_xyz = Rz(rotation_z_deg) @ asset_local_xyz + position_m; no scaling; each asset source origin is recorded
manifest.source_license_status: Original source terms remain applicable; full reuse/redistribution audit pending.

validation.scope: 2D complete-footprint placement and overlap checks only; no RT, watertight mesh, road routing or electromagnetic validation.

manifest.layout: 4000 m irregular collector network, recursive unequal street blocks, preserved screened Boston/ASU groups; not a scaled 10000 m grid
manifest.channel_status: Not recomputed. Earlier 1km trial used preview/assumed materials and is not attached to this resource version.

ground.material_status: Synthetic ground; source terrain/material not transplanted. Requires explicit new-city material assignment.
